title: Read-only CanAdd unknown native names and session UID controls
question: Does a Shape Contents Indexed Group admit an unregistered Shape/Graphic/Filter-prefixed match name, independently of actual factory type construction? Why does UID return zero for every stream?
procedure: Quit AE; replace AEX only while closed; restart in disposable AE project
Select native Shape Layer; choose Animation > ShapeLayerAE: Probe Unknown Shape Names (Experimental)
Record all TSVs and exact AE/TDB build hashes; never call AddStream on unknown names
Compare UID first and second calls preinitialized with two distinct nonzero sentinels
Interpret CanAdd=true only as parent admission, never as safe instantiation
conclusion: Probe compiled; no v3 AE runtime results yet.
limitations: Unknown-name CanAdd is unsupported/advisory query and may still emit host errors
No native stream mutation in this experiment
